name: An agent's scopes are kept on the agent; a new credential carries exactly them
summary: Stored scopes govern renewal; dead or wider credentials cannot reset them. Only the owner confirms inferred/unknown scopes; non-owner lists refuse 403 and plain renewal 409 asks for the owner. Confirmed scopes can be narrowed by an authorized account, widened only by the owner. Names/printable labels (stripped, max 64) are validated; reads never confirm. Retain at most 20 working/newest 5 dead credentials; pruning removes indexes. One renewal/revoke audit event records IDs, actor/account/request/time, and scopes/source before/after; disable events name affected IDs. No labels/secrets/hashes/paths. Audit has a shared 10,000-entry service-state tail. Issuance saves before its replay receipt; failed save rolls back issuance and retains refusal audit/prior pending state. Crash/receipt failure may leave 409 in-progress. Failed revoke save keeps access revoked in memory, pending a successful save; not durable across restart. The page warns before owner confirmation, hides non-owner confirmation forms, and pages 20 filtered cards. See documentation for details. This remains an unaccepted proposal.
